en:
Marching to relieve the Takeda,
the Kumagai and Kikkawa armies
fell on the Ouchi Army from behind
and gained the upper hand.


But the more numerous Ouchi Army
gradually regrouped its ranks,
and the tide of battle turned.
Carried deep by their momentum,
the Kumagai and Kikkawa armies
were surrounded and cornered.
